title: Dependence of a real-valued sign function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$ to signs, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Regard each output sign of $f$ as the corresponding real number, defining a real-valued function on the same domain. This real-valued function depends only on the coordinates in $S$ if and only if $f$ itself depends only on the coordinates in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors of length $n$ to signs
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
